board_events.text: TRUE POLYEMBRYONY — multiple embryos in the SAME embryo sac.
FALSE POLYEMBRYONY — embryos in DIFFERENT embryo sacs within ONE ovule.
GAMETOPHYTIC — the extra embryos arise from HAPLOID cells of the embryo sac.
SPOROPHYTIC — they arise from DIPLOID maternal structures such as the NUCELLUS.
TWO INDEPENDENT questions: WHERE the embryos sit, and WHICH CELL they came from. Do not merge the vocabularies.
SPOROPHYTIC = maternal = diploid = CLONAL. The chain runs all the way through.

segments.text: Polyembryony gets classified two ways, and this is exactly the shape we met with carpels back in Part one. Two independent questions, two vocabularies, and a trap if you merge them.

Question one is about location. Where do the embryos sit relative to the sac? True polyembryony means multiple embryos in the same embryo sac. False polyembryony means embryos in different sacs within one ovule.

Note what false is not. It is not fake polyembryony. There really are several embryos in one seed. It is called false only because they are not sharing a single sac — the technical criterion was not met.

Question two is about origin. Which cell did the extra embryo come from? Gametophytic means it arose from haploid cells of the embryo sac. Sporophytic means from diploid maternal structures, such as the nucellus.

And these two questions are genuinely independent. Location does not tell you origin, and origin does not tell you location. An exam can ask either, and merging the vocabularies is how marks get lost.
<curious> Now look at what the sporophytic branch is actually saying, because a chain runs through it that ties this whole subtopic together.
Sporophytic means from the plant body. The plant body is maternal. Maternal tissue is diploid. And a diploid maternal origin, with no meiosis and no fertilisation, means clonal.

So sporophytic equals maternal equals diploid equals clonal. Four words, one chain, running from a classification term all the way to a farmer's orchard. That is nucellar embryony, filed under its formal name.
Polyembryony को दो तरीक़ों से classify किया जाता है, और ये बिल्कुल वही आकार है जो हमने Part एक में carpels के साथ देखा था। दो अलग सवाल, दो vocabularies, और मिला दिया तो trap।
पहला सवाल जगह का है। Embryos sac के सापेक्ष कहाँ बैठे हैं? True polyembryony यानी एक ही embryo sac में कई embryos। False polyembryony यानी एक ही ovule के अंदर अलग-अलग sacs में embryos।

ध्यान दीजिए false का मतलब क्या नहीं है। इसका मतलब नक़ली polyembryony नहीं है। एक seed में सचमुच कई embryos हैं। इसे false सिर्फ़ इसलिए कहते हैं कि वो एक ही sac साझा नहीं कर रहे — तकनीकी शर्त पूरी नहीं हुई।
दूसरा सवाल origin का है। Extra embryo किस cell से आया? Gametophytic यानी embryo sac की haploid cells से बना। Sporophytic यानी diploid maternal structures से, जैसे nucellus।
और ये दोनों सवाल सचमुच अलग हैं। जगह से origin नहीं पता चलता, और origin से जगह नहीं। Exam कोई भी पूछ सकता है, और vocabularies मिलाना ही marks गँवाने का तरीक़ा है।
<curious> अब देखिए sporophytic शाखा सचमुच कह क्या रही है, क्योंकि उसमें से एक कड़ी गुज़रती है जो पूरे subtopic को बाँध देती है।
Sporophytic यानी plant body से। Plant body maternal है। Maternal tissue diploid है। और diploid maternal origin, बिना meiosis और बिना fertilization के, यानी clonal।

तो sporophytic बराबर maternal बराबर diploid बराबर clonal। चार शब्द, एक कड़ी, जो एक classification term से चलकर सीधे किसान के बाग़ तक जाती है। यही nucellar embryony है, अपने औपचारिक नाम के नीचे रखी हुई।

board_events.text: NUCELLAR POLYEMBRYONY is the commercially important type: maternal nucellar tissue produces extra embryos that are genetically UNIFORM CLONES of the parent.
REASON 1 — the seedlings BREED TRUE TO TYPE, preserving an ELITE VARIETY.
REASON 2 — nucellar embryos are SUPERIOR to plants raised by ordinary vegetative propagation.
They tend to be DISEASE-FREE and retain their VIGOUR for a long time.
NEET asks for exactly TWO reasons: 'State two reasons why nucellar embryos are considered superior to plants raised by ordinary vegetative propagation.'
Answer: genetically uniform clones (true-breeding), AND disease-free with long-retained vigour.

segments.text: Of all the polyembryony types, one is commercially important, and it is the one we have already built. Nucellar polyembryony — maternal nucellar tissue producing extra embryos that are genetically uniform clones of the parent.
The source gives exactly two reasons why this matters, and N E E T asks for exactly two. So learn them as a pair, and learn them as a numbered pair.
Reason one: the seedlings breed true to type, preserving an elite variety. This is the farmer's perfect mango from earlier, now solved. The prize combination survives the seed.
Reason two is the one students forget, and it is the more interesting claim. Nucellar embryos are superior to plants raised by ordinary vegetative propagation.
<curious> Pause on that, because it is not obvious. Cuttings and grafting are already clonal. They already preserve the variety. So why would a nucellar seedling beat them?

Because of what it avoids. Nucellar embryos tend to be disease-free and retain their vigour for a long time. A cutting carries whatever the parent branch was carrying — including its viruses and its age.
A seed does not. The seed route resets something that vegetative propagation cannot. So you get the genetic uniformity of a clone, with the health of a fresh seedling. Both, at once.

So when the paper asks for two reasons why nucellar embryos are superior, give both halves cleanly. One: genetically uniform clones, true-breeding. Two: disease-free, with vigour retained for a long time.

सारे polyembryony types में से एक commercially ज़रूरी है, और वो वही है जो हम पहले ही बना चुके हैं। Nucellar polyembryony — जहाँ maternal nucellar tissue वो extra embryos बनाता है जो parent के genetically uniform clones हैं।
Source ठीक दो वजहें देता है कि ये क्यों मायने रखता है, और N E E T ठीक दो ही माँगता है। तो इन्हें जोड़ी की तरह सीखिए, और numbered जोड़ी की तरह।
पहली वजह: seedlings true to type breed करते हैं, और एक elite variety को बचा लेते हैं। यही पहले वाला किसान का perfect आम है, अब हल हो चुका। जीतने वाला combination seed से बचकर निकल आता है।
दूसरी वजह वो है जो students भूल जाते हैं, और ये ज़्यादा दिलचस्प दावा है। Nucellar embryos आम vegetative propagation से उगाए पौधों से बेहतर होते हैं।
<curious> यहाँ रुकिए, क्योंकि ये ज़ाहिर नहीं है। Cuttings और grafting तो पहले से clonal हैं। वो variety पहले से बचाते हैं। तो nucellar seedling उनसे बेहतर क्यों निकलेगा?

क्योंकि वो जिनसे बच जाता है। Nucellar embryos आम तौर पर disease-free होते हैं और लंबे समय तक अपनी vigour बनाए रखते हैं। Cutting वो सब ढोकर लाती है जो parent शाखा ढो रही थी — उसके viruses और उसकी उम्र समेत।
Seed नहीं ढोता। Seed वाला रास्ता वो चीज़ दोबारा शून्य कर देता है जो vegetative propagation नहीं कर सकती। तो आपको clone की genetic uniformity मिलती है, और ताज़ा seedling की सेहत। दोनों, एक साथ।
तो जब paper दो वजहें पूछे कि nucellar embryos बेहतर क्यों हैं, तो दोनों हिस्से साफ़-साफ़ दीजिए। एक: genetically uniform clones, true-breeding। दो: disease-free, और लंबे समय तक बनी रहने वाली vigour।

board_events.text: ALLIUM ODORUM — FIVE embryos recorded arising by DIFFERENT methods at once.
One from the ZYGOTE, one from a SYNERGID, TWO from ANTIPODAL cells, and one from an INTEGUMENTARY cell.
THE RECORD-HOLDER: Citrus unshiu — as many as FORTY embryos reported inside a single seed.
NECROHORMONE THEORY (Haberlandt, 1921) — the classical explanation for nucellar budding.
As some nucellar cells DEGENERATE, they release a stimulus that prompts neighbouring cells to switch on and develop into embryos.
In practice, only ONE embryo usually survives to maturity — but the phenomenon is what makes nucellar lines so useful in horticulture.

segments.text: A short section of striking facts, and the first one is a genuine surprise: several of these routes can operate in the same seed, at the same time.
Allium odorum is the illustration. Five embryos have been recorded in one seed, arising by different methods at once — and the list is worth hearing in full, because it uses cells you already know.
One from the zygote — the ordinary sexual route. One from a synergid. Two from antipodal cells. And one from an integumentary cell. Five embryos, four different origins, one seed.

<excited> Sit with the synergids and antipodals for a second. In the last part, those cells degenerated after fertilisation. Here, some of them become embryos instead. The helper cells took a different job.
Now the record-holder, and the number is absurd. Citrus unshiu, with as many as forty embryos reported inside a single seed. Forty plants, waiting in one seed coat.
The classical explanation for nucellar budding is the necrohormone theory, from Haberlandt, nineteen twenty-one. And the mechanism it proposes is strange in a way worth appreciating.
As some nucellar cells degenerate, they release a stimulus that prompts neighbouring cells to switch on and develop into embryos. Necro means death. Cells dying is the signal that starts new lives.
One honest caveat to finish. In practice, only one embryo usually survives to maturity. The forty do not become forty trees. But the phenomenon is what makes nucellar lines so useful in horticulture.
चौंकाने वाले facts का एक छोटा section, और पहला ही सचमुच हैरान करता है: इनमें से कई रास्ते एक ही seed में, एक ही समय पर चल सकते हैं।
इसका उदाहरण है Allium odorum। एक ही seed में पाँच embryos दर्ज किए गए हैं, जो एक साथ अलग-अलग तरीक़ों से बने — और पूरी list सुनने लायक़ है, क्योंकि इसमें वही cells हैं जो आप पहले से जानते हैं।
एक zygote से — यानी आम sexual रास्ता। एक synergid से। दो antipodal cells से। और एक integumentary cell से। पाँच embryos, चार अलग origins, एक seed।
<excited> Synergids और antipodals पर एक पल रुकिए। पिछले part में वो cells fertilization के बाद degenerate हो जाती थीं। यहाँ उनमें से कुछ embryos बन जाती हैं। सहायक cells ने दूसरी नौकरी पकड़ ली।
अब record-holder, और ये संख्या बेतुकी है। Citrus unshiu, जिसमें एक ही seed के अंदर चालीस तक embryos दर्ज किए गए हैं। चालीस पौधे, एक seed coat में इंतज़ार करते हुए।
Nucellar budding की classical व्याख्या है necrohormone theory, Haberlandt से, उन्नीस सौ इक्कीस। और ये जो mechanism सुझाती है, वो एक ख़ास तरह से अजीब है।

जैसे-जैसे कुछ nucellar cells degenerate होती हैं, वो एक stimulus छोड़ती हैं जो पड़ोसी cells को चालू करके embryos बना देता है। Necro यानी मृत्यु। Cells का मरना ही वो संकेत है जो नई ज़िंदगियाँ शुरू करता है।
आख़िर में एक ईमानदार चेतावनी। व्यवहार में, आम तौर पर सिर्फ़ एक ही embryo maturity तक बचता है। चालीस से चालीस पेड़ नहीं बनते। लेकिन यही घटना nucellar lines को horticulture में इतना उपयोगी बनाती है।

board_events.text: APOMIXIS → a SEED without fertilization. An embryo DOES form — just asexually.
PARTHENOCARPY → a SEEDLESS FRUIT without fertilization. NO embryo, no seed at all.
ONE is about making a SEED asexually. The OTHER is about making a FRUIT with no seed.
MCQ form: 'Apomixis differs from parthenocarpy in that apomixis results in — (b) a seed without fertilisation.'
The distractors: (a) 'a seedless fruit' describes PARTHENOCARPY. (d) 'increased genetic variation' is the REVERSE of the truth.
Apomixis is clonal and produces NO new variation. Any option linking apomixis to variation is wrong.

segments.text: The N C E R T Exemplar poses this comparison directly, and it is the single most reliable question in this subtopic. So make the distinction clean enough that it cannot wobble.
Apomixis gives a seed without fertilisation. And the crucial detail: an embryo does form. It forms asexually, from a diploid maternal cell, but a real embryo exists inside a real seed.
Parthenocarpy gives a seedless fruit without fertilisation. No embryo. No seed at all. The ovary swelled into a fruit while the ovules produced nothing.
So state it in one line and carry it. One is about making a seed asexually. The other is about making a fruit with no seed. They share only the words without fertilisation.
Now the standard M C Q form. Apomixis differs from parthenocarpy in that apomixis results in — and the answer is a seed without fertilisation. Straight from the distinction.
<whisper> The distractors are worth naming individually, because each one teaches something. Option a says a seedless fruit — that is parthenocarpy, offered back to you as if it were apomixis.

Option c says a fruit without an ovary, which is simply impossible — a fruit is the mature ovary, so there is no such thing. And option d says increased genetic variation, which is the reverse of the truth.

That last one is the important trap, so let it become a reflex. Apomixis is clonal and produces no new variation. Any option that links apomixis to variation is wrong, every time, without further thought.
N C E R T Exemplar ये तुलना सीधे पूछता है, और इस subtopic का यही सबसे भरोसेमंद question है। तो फ़र्क़ को इतना साफ़ कर लीजिए कि वो डगमगा ही न सके।
Apomixis बिना fertilization के seed देती है। और अहम बारीक़ी: embryo बनता ज़रूर है। वो asexually बनता है, किसी diploid maternal cell से, लेकिन असली seed के अंदर असली embryo मौजूद है।
Parthenocarpy बिना fertilization के seedless fruit देती है। कोई embryo नहीं। कोई seed नहीं। Ovary फूलकर fruit बन गई जबकि ovules ने कुछ बनाया ही नहीं।
तो इसे एक line में कहकर साथ रखिए। एक seed को asexually बनाने की बात है। दूसरी बिना seed वाला fruit बनाने की। इनमें साझा सिर्फ़ इतना है — without fertilization।
अब आम M C Q वाला रूप। Apomixis parthenocarpy से इस मायने में अलग है कि apomixis देती है — और जवाब है, बिना fertilization के एक seed। सीधे उसी फ़र्क़ से।
<whisper> Distractors को अलग-अलग नाम देना फ़ायदेमंद है, क्योंकि हर एक कुछ सिखाता है। Option ए कहता है seedless fruit — वो parthenocarpy है, जो आपको apomixis बताकर वापस परोसा जा रहा है।
Option सी कहता है बिना ovary वाला fruit, जो नामुमकिन ही है — fruit तो mature ovary है, तो ऐसी कोई चीज़ होती ही नहीं। और option डी कहता है बढ़ी हुई genetic variation, जो सच का उल्टा है।
वो आख़िरी वाला ही असली trap है, तो इसे reflex बना लीजिए। Apomixis clonal है और कोई नई variation पैदा नहीं करती। जो भी option apomixis को variation से जोड़े, वो ग़लत है — हर बार, बिना और सोचे।

board_events.text: The very feature apomixis LACKS is the one sexual reproduction exists to PROVIDE: VARIATION.
In sexual reproduction, gamete formation is preceded by MEIOSIS, and the CROSSING OVER in meiosis-I reshuffles segments of DNA between homologous chromosomes.
So the gametes — and the offspring they produce — carry many NEW GENETIC COMBINATIONS.
That diversity is an INSURANCE POLICY: in a changing environment, a varied population is far more likely to contain individuals that survive a new disease, a drought, or a shift in climate.
Apomixis trades exactly this away. Its clones are superbly adapted to TODAY's conditions but carry NO genetic novelty for TOMORROW's.
COMPLEMENTARY BETS: apomixis wagers on STABILITY, sexual reproduction on CHANGE — which is why many apomictic plants are FACULTATIVE, keeping the sexual route as a fallback.

segments.text: The chapter closes with the question it has been building toward. If apomixis is so convenient — true-breeding seed, no need for pollinators, hybrid vigour locked in — why has sexual reproduction not been abandoned across the plant world?
Because the very feature apomixis lacks is the one sexual reproduction exists to provide. Variation. Everything else sex does is expensive and inconvenient; this is what the plant is paying for.
Look at how that variation is actually manufactured. Gamete formation is preceded by meiosis, and the crossing over in meiosis-one reshuffles segments of D N A between homologous chromosomes.

So the gametes — and the offspring they produce — carry many new genetic combinations. This is the hinge from Part one, seen from the other side. We called it a ploidy device; it is also a variation engine.

<curious> And here is the framing worth keeping. That diversity is an insurance policy. Not an improvement, not an upgrade — insurance. You do not buy it because today is bad. You buy it because tomorrow is unknown.
In a changing environment, a varied population is far more likely to contain individuals that survive a new disease, a drought, or a shift in climate. Somebody in the crowd happens to be resistant.

Apomixis trades exactly this away. Its clones are superbly adapted to today's conditions but carry no genetic novelty for tomorrow's. If the world holds still, they win. If it moves, they all fail together.

So the two are complementary bets, not rivals. Apomixis wagers on stability, sexual reproduction on change. Which is why many apomictic plants are facultative — they keep the sexual route available as a fallback rather than abandoning it entirely.

Chapter उसी सवाल पर ख़त्म होता है जिसकी तरफ़ वो बढ़ रहा था। अगर apomixis इतनी सुविधाजनक है — true-breeding seed, pollinators की ज़रूरत नहीं, hybrid vigour पक्की — तो पूरी plant दुनिया ने sexual reproduction छोड़ क्यों नहीं दी?
क्योंकि जो ख़ूबी apomixis में नहीं है, sexual reproduction का वजूद ही उसे देने के लिए है। Variation। Sex जो कुछ और करती है वो महँगा और असुविधाजनक है; plant क़ीमत इसी एक चीज़ की चुका रहा है।
देखिए वो variation बनती कैसे है। Gamete बनने से पहले meiosis होती है, और meiosis-one में होने वाला crossing over homologous chromosomes के बीच D N A के हिस्से दोबारा फेंट देता है।

इसलिए gametes — और उनसे बनने वाली संतानें — बहुत सारे नए genetic combinations लेकर चलती हैं। यही Part एक वाली hinge है, दूसरी तरफ़ से देखी हुई। हमने उसे ploidy का औज़ार कहा था; वो variation का engine भी है।
<curious> और यही वो framing है जो रखने लायक़ है। वो विविधता एक बीमा policy है। कोई सुधार नहीं, कोई upgrade नहीं — बीमा। आप इसे इसलिए नहीं ख़रीदते कि आज बुरा है। आप इसलिए ख़रीदते हैं कि कल अनजान है।
बदलते माहौल में, विविध आबादी में कहीं ज़्यादा संभावना है कि कोई ऐसा हो जो नई बीमारी, सूखे, या जलवायु के बदलाव से बच जाए। भीड़ में कोई न कोई प्रतिरोधी निकल ही आता है।
Apomixis ठीक यही सौदे में दे देती है। उसके clones आज के हालात के लिए बेहतरीन हैं लेकिन कल के लिए कोई genetic नयापन नहीं रखते। दुनिया ठहरी रहे तो वो जीतते हैं। हिल जाए तो सब साथ मरते हैं।

तो ये दोनों एक-दूसरे के पूरक दाँव हैं, प्रतिद्वंद्वी नहीं। Apomixis स्थिरता पर दाँव लगाती है, sexual reproduction बदलाव पर। और इसीलिए बहुत सारे apomictic plants facultative होते हैं — वो sexual रास्ता पूरी तरह छोड़ते नहीं, उसे fallback की तरह बचाकर रखते हैं।

sections.title: Worked example 1 — define apomixis, and say why the seed industry wants it

board_events.text: CBSE Board · 2 marks
What is apomixis? State one reason it is valuable to the hybrid-seed industry.

board_events.caption: Two marks, two deliverables

board_events.text: MODEL ANSWER — Apomixis is the formation of SEEDS WITHOUT MEIOSIS AND FERTILIZATION: a form of asexual reproduction that MIMICS sexual reproduction and yields offspring that are CLONES of the mother.
It is valuable because hybrid plants that are apomictic would produce seeds that BREED TRUE.
So farmers could re-sow saved seed year after year WITHOUT LOSING HYBRID VIGOUR.
FULL MARKS: state BOTH 'without meiosis and fertilisation' AND 'preserves hybrid vigour / true-breeding seed'. Two marks, two deliverables.
A two-mark question is a two-item checklist. Write both items and stop.

segments.text: A two-mark board question, and the arithmetic tells you the shape before you read a word of biology. Two marks, two deliverables. Find them, write them, stop.
The question: what is apomixis, and state one reason it is valuable to the hybrid-seed industry. So deliverable one is a definition, deliverable two is a reason. Nothing else is being marked.
Now the definition, and it must carry both exclusions. Apomixis is the formation of seeds without meiosis and fertilisation.

Do not write only one of those. A candidate who writes without fertilisation and stops has described something that still has meiosis in it — and meiosis alone would break the clonal result. Both, every time.
Then add the two clauses that complete it. It is a form of asexual reproduction that mimics sexual reproduction, and it yields offspring that are clones of the mother. Mechanism, appearance, outcome.
Now deliverable two, the reason. Hybrid plants that are apomictic would produce seeds that breed true — so farmers could re-sow saved seed year after year without losing hybrid vigour.
<whisper> And the full-marks tip is explicit about which words are ticked. State both without meiosis and fertilisation, and preserves hybrid vigour or true-breeding seed. Those are the two boxes.

So resist the urge to write a paragraph about photocopiers and mangoes. That was for understanding. The answer is two sentences, each carrying one marked item, and the examiner is looking for exactly those.
एक दो-mark वाला board question, और गणित ही इसकी shape बता देता है — biology का एक शब्द पढ़ने से पहले। दो marks, दो deliverables। ढूँढिए, लिखिए, रुक जाइए।
Question: apomixis क्या है, और एक वजह बताइए कि ये hybrid-seed industry के लिए क़ीमती क्यों है। तो पहला deliverable definition है, दूसरा एक वजह। इसके अलावा कुछ marked नहीं है।
अब definition, और इसमें दोनों बहिष्कार होने ही चाहिए। Apomixis बिना meiosis और बिना fertilization के seeds बनने की प्रक्रिया है।
इनमें से सिर्फ़ एक मत लिखिए। जिसने सिर्फ़ without fertilization लिखकर छोड़ दिया, उसने ऐसी चीज़ बताई जिसमें meiosis अब भी मौजूद है — और अकेली meiosis ही clonal नतीजे को तोड़ देती। दोनों, हर बार।
फिर वो दो हिस्से जोड़िए जो इसे पूरा करते हैं। ये asexual reproduction का वो रूप है जो sexual reproduction की नक़ल करता है, और जिसकी संतानें माँ के clones होती हैं। Mechanism, शक्ल, नतीजा।
अब दूसरा deliverable, यानी वजह। जो hybrid plants apomictic हैं, वो ऐसे seeds बनाएँगे जो breed true करें — यानी किसान बचाया हुआ बीज साल दर साल बो सकें, बिना hybrid vigour खोए।
<whisper> और full-marks tip साफ़ बताती है कि कौन से शब्द tick होते हैं। दोनों लिखिए — without meiosis and fertilisation, और preserves hybrid vigour या true-breeding seed। यही दो डिब्बे हैं।
तो photocopier और आम पर पूरा paragraph लिखने की इच्छा को रोकिए। वो समझने के लिए था। जवाब दो वाक्यों का है, हर वाक्य में एक marked item, और examiner ठीक वही ढूँढ रहा है।

board_events.text: FAST REASONING — the trap is that THREE of these are CLONAL (no variation).
Parthenogenesis, nucellar polyembryony and vegetative reproduction ALL skip meiosis / recombination.
Only SEXUAL REPRODUCTION mixes genomes via meiosis AND fertilization.
ANSWER: (d). If you remember 'apomixis / clonal = no variation', you eliminate (a), (b) and (c) INSTANTLY.
This is a one-tag question: sort every option into CLONAL or SEXUAL, and the answer is whatever is left.

segments.text: A speed trap, and this one is almost pure classification. You do not need to know anything clever — you need one tag, applied to four options.
The question: which one of the following generates new genetic combinations leading to variation? Parthenogenesis, nucellar polyembryony, vegetative reproduction, or sexual reproduction.

Now apply the tag. Every term in this subtopic is either clonal — no variation, diploid, maternal — or sexual, meaning variation, involving meiosis. That is the only distinction the question is testing.
Parthenogenesis: an unfertilised egg developing into an organism. No fertilisation, no mixing of two genomes. Clonal in effect. Eliminated.
Nucellar polyembryony: embryos from maternal, diploid nucellar tissue. We spent a whole section on why these are clones. Definitively clonal. Eliminated.
Vegetative reproduction: runners, bulbs, cuttings. Pure mitosis, pure copying. There is no gamete anywhere in the process. Clonal. Eliminated.
<excited> And that leaves sexual reproduction, which mixes genomes via meiosis and fertilisation. Both engines running — crossing over shuffles, fertilisation combines. The answer is option d.

So name the trap. Three of the four are clonal, and the examiner is betting you will read each option carefully and lose ninety seconds. But if you hold clonal equals no variation, all three collapse at once and the answer is whatever survives.
एक speed trap, और ये लगभग पूरी तरह classification का सवाल है। आपको कुछ चतुर जानने की ज़रूरत नहीं — आपको एक tag चाहिए, जो चारों options पर लगे।
Question: इनमें से कौन सा नए genetic combinations बनाता है जिससे variation आती है? Parthenogenesis, nucellar polyembryony, vegetative reproduction, या sexual reproduction।
अब tag लगाइए। इस subtopic का हर term या तो clonal है — कोई variation नहीं, diploid, maternal — या sexual है, यानी variation, जिसमें meiosis शामिल है। बस यही एक फ़र्क़ ये question जाँच रहा है।
Parthenogenesis: बिना fertilise हुआ egg सीधे organism बन जाता है। कोई fertilization नहीं, दो genomes की कोई मिलावट नहीं। असर में clonal। बाहर।
Nucellar polyembryony: maternal, diploid nucellar tissue से बने embryos। हमने पूरा एक section इसी पर लगाया कि ये clones क्यों हैं। पक्का clonal। बाहर।
Vegetative reproduction: runners, bulbs, cuttings। शुद्ध mitosis, शुद्ध नक़ल। पूरी प्रक्रिया में कहीं कोई gamete है ही नहीं। Clonal। बाहर।
<excited> और बचती है sexual reproduction, जो meiosis और fertilization के ज़रिए genomes मिलाती है। दोनों engine चालू — crossing over फेंटता है, fertilization जोड़ता है। जवाब है option डी।

तो trap को नाम दीजिए। चार में से तीन clonal हैं, और examiner दाँव लगा रहा है कि आप हर option ध्यान से पढ़ेंगे और नब्बे seconds गँवाएँगे। लेकिन अगर clonal बराबर no variation पकड़े रहे, तो तीनों एक साथ ढह जाते हैं और जवाब वही है जो बच गया।

board_events.text: A → 2. DIPLOSPORY is the MMC route — the megaspore mother cell itself becomes the diploid sac.
B → 3. APOSPORY is the outside-cell embryo-sac route — a neighbour builds an extra sac.
C → 1. ADVENTIVE EMBRYONY skips the embryo sac entirely. ANSWER: A-2, B-3, C-1.
One question sorts all three rows: WHERE does the embryo start?

segments.text: A three-row matching question, and we already built the tool that solves it. One question sorts every row: where does the embryo start?

The routes: diplospory, apospory, adventive embryony. The descriptions offered: a nucellar cell bypassing the sac, the megaspore mother cell becoming a diploid sac, and a somatic cell forming an extra sac.

Start with A, diplospory. Break the word: diplo means double, spory refers to the spore. The megaspore mother cell itself develops directly into a diploid embryo sac. It starts at the megaspore mother cell.
So A matches description two — the megaspore mother cell develops directly into a diploid embryo sac. A goes to two. Right cell, wrong division, and the word told you.
Now B, apospory. Apo means away or apart — the same apo you met in apocarpous back in Part one, where the carpels were free and separate. Away from. So it starts away from the megaspore mother cell.
And that is description three: a somatic cell outside the embryo sac forms an extra embryo sac. B goes to three. The prefix carried the answer across two whole subtopics.
<curious> Finally C, adventive embryony. Adventive means arriving from outside, added on — the same root as adventitious roots, which sprout where roots have no business sprouting.
So C matches description one: the embryo forms directly from a diploid nucellar or integumentary cell, bypassing the embryo sac entirely. C goes to one. The answer is A-two, B-three, C-one.
तीन rows वाला matching question, और इसे हल करने वाला औज़ार हम पहले ही बना चुके हैं। एक ही सवाल हर row छाँट देता है: embryo शुरू कहाँ से होता है?
Routes: diplospory, apospory, adventive embryony। और सामने descriptions: sac को छोड़कर बनने वाली nucellar cell, megaspore mother cell का ख़ुद diploid sac बन जाना, और somatic cell का extra sac बनाना।
A से शुरू कीजिए — diplospory। शब्द तोड़िए: diplo यानी दोहरा, और spory यानी spore से जुड़ा। Megaspore mother cell ख़ुद सीधे diploid embryo sac बन जाता है। यानी शुरुआत megaspore mother cell पर।
तो A मिलता है description दो से — megaspore mother cell सीधे diploid embryo sac बन जाता है। A जाता है दो पर। सही cell, ग़लत division, और शब्द ने ख़ुद बता दिया।
अब B — apospory। Apo यानी दूर या अलग — वही apo जो आपने Part एक में apocarpous में देखा था, जहाँ carpels अलग-अलग और आज़ाद थे। दूर से। यानी शुरुआत megaspore mother cell से दूर।
और यही description तीन है: embryo sac के बाहर की एक somatic cell एक extra embryo sac बना देती है। B जाता है तीन पर। Prefix जवाब को दो पूरे subtopics के आर-पार ढोकर ले आया।
<curious> आख़िर में C — adventive embryony। Adventive का मतलब है बाहर से आया हुआ, ऊपर से जुड़ा — वही root जो adventitious roots में है, जो वहाँ निकल आती हैं जहाँ जड़ों का कोई काम नहीं।
तो C मिलता है description एक से: embryo सीधे किसी diploid nucellar या integumentary cell से बनता है, और embryo sac को पूरी तरह छोड़ देता है। C जाता है एक पर। जवाब है A-दो, B-तीन, C-एक।

sections.title: Worked example 4 — the Reason that states the opposite

board_events.text: NEET · Assertion–Reason
KEY: (a) both true, R explains A; (b) both true, R not the explanation; (c) A true, R false; (d) A false, R true.
ASSERTION (A): Apomictic offspring are genetically identical to the parent plant. REASON (R): Apomixis involves meiosis followed by syngamy.

board_events.caption: R contradicts the very mechanism behind A

board_events.text: A is TRUE — apomictic seedlings are CLONES.
R is FALSE — apomixis specifically SKIPS both meiosis and syngamy.
And skipping both is PRECISELY why the offspring are clones. ANSWER: (c).
This is the single most common APOMIXIS TRAP: the Reason states the OPPOSITE of the truth.

segments.text: The last worked example of the chapter, and it breaks the pattern the previous three assertion–reasons set. Run the drill anyway — this is exactly the one where skipping it costs you.
The assertion: apomictic offspring are genetically identical to the parent plant. Is that true? Yes. Apomictic seedlings are clones. That is the defining outcome of the whole mechanism.
Now the reason: apomixis involves meiosis followed by syngamy. And here you should stop, because something is badly wrong.
<excited> That is false. Apomixis specifically skips both meiosis and syngamy. The reason has not merely failed to explain the assertion — it has asserted the exact opposite of the mechanism.
So the answer is option c: A true, R false. And notice the drill saved you. Had you pattern-matched from the last three answers being a, you would have walked straight into it.

But there is a deeper cruelty here worth seeing, because it is what makes this trap so effective. The reason does not just happen to be false. It is false in a way that destroys the assertion it sits beside.
If apomixis really did involve meiosis followed by syngamy, the offspring would not be clones at all — they would be a new genetic mix. The reason, if true, would make the assertion false.

<whisper> The source calls this the single most common apomixis trap: the reason states the opposite of the truth. So build the reflex. If a reason attaches meiosis or syngamy to apomixis, it is false. Always.
Chapter का आख़िरी worked example, और ये पिछले तीन assertion–reasons वाला pattern तोड़ देता है। Drill फिर भी चलाइए — यही वो सवाल है जहाँ उसे छोड़ना भारी पड़ता है।
Assertion: apomictic संतानें parent plant से genetically identical होती हैं। क्या ये सही है? हाँ। Apomictic seedlings clones होते हैं। यही तो पूरे mechanism का परिभाषित नतीजा है।
अब reason: apomixis में meiosis होती है और उसके बाद syngamy। और यहीं आपको रुक जाना चाहिए, क्योंकि कुछ बहुत ग़लत है।
<excited> ये ग़लत है। Apomixis ख़ास तौर पर meiosis और syngamy, दोनों को छोड़ती है। Reason सिर्फ़ assertion को explain करने में नाकाम नहीं हुआ — उसने mechanism का बिल्कुल उल्टा कह दिया है।
तो जवाब है option सी: A सही, R ग़लत। और देखिए drill ने आपको बचा लिया। अगर आप पिछले तीन जवाब ए देखकर pattern पकड़ लेते, तो सीधे इसी में जा गिरते।
लेकिन यहाँ एक गहरी क्रूरता भी है जो देखने लायक़ है, क्योंकि यही इस trap को इतना कारगर बनाती है। Reason बस इत्तेफ़ाक़ से ग़लत नहीं है। वो इस तरह ग़लत है कि अपने बग़ल वाली assertion को ही तोड़ देता है।
अगर apomixis में सचमुच meiosis और फिर syngamy होती, तो संतानें clones होती ही नहीं — वो एक नया genetic मिश्रण होतीं। Reason अगर सही होता, तो assertion को ग़लत बना देता।
<whisper> Source इसे apomixis का सबसे common trap कहता है: reason सच का उल्टा बयान करता है। तो reflex बना लीजिए। अगर कोई reason apomixis के साथ meiosis या syngamy जोड़े, तो वो ग़लत है। हमेशा।

sections.title: Pitfalls 1 and 2 — the trio, and the meiosis claim

board_events.text: PITFALL 1 · Apomixis vs parthenocarpy vs parthenogenesis
SEED without fertilisation → APOMIXIS. SEEDLESS FRUIT without fertilisation → PARTHENOCARPY. ANIMAL EGG developing without fertilisation → PARTHENOGENESIS.
This trio is tested CONSTANTLY — keep three separate boxes.
PITFALL 2 · 'Apomixis involves meiosis / syngamy'
It does the OPPOSITE — it SKIPS BOTH.
This false statement is the favourite Assertion–Reason trap in the whole chapter.
Both pitfalls are about the same habit: reading a familiar word and assuming a familiar process.
Apomixis LOOKS sexual. That is what 'mimics' means — and it is exactly what the traps exploit.

segments.text: Four pitfalls close this chapter, and the first two are the ones that cost the most marks. Notice, as we go, that both come from the same habit.

Pitfall one: the three without-fertilisation terms. Seed without fertilisation is apomixis. Seedless fruit without fertilisation is parthenocarpy. An animal egg developing without fertilisation is parthenogenesis.

The source says this trio is tested constantly, and constantly is a strong word. Keep three separate boxes, and sort by the product — seed, fruit, or animal — never by the prefix they happen to share.
Pitfall two: the claim that apomixis involves meiosis or syngamy. It does the opposite. It skips both. And this false statement is the favourite assertion–reason trap in the whole chapter.
You have just seen it fire in worked example four. The reason looked plausible, used the right vocabulary, sat beside a true assertion — and stated the exact reverse of the mechanism.
<curious> Now look at what both pitfalls have in common, because seeing it is worth more than memorising either. Both come from reading a familiar word and assuming a familiar process.

Apomixis uses the ovule. It makes a seed. It looks, from the outside, exactly like the sexual route we spent three parts building. So the mind supplies meiosis and syngamy automatically, because they belong there.

But that resemblance is the whole point of the word mimics. Apomixis is designed to look sexual while being nothing of the kind — and the examiner is exploiting precisely the illusion the plant evolved.
चार pitfalls इस chapter को ख़त्म करते हैं, और पहले दो ही सबसे ज़्यादा marks ले जाते हैं। आगे बढ़ते हुए ध्यान दीजिए कि दोनों एक ही आदत से आते हैं।

पहला pitfall: तीनों without-fertilisation terms। बिना fertilization के seed यानी apomixis। बिना fertilization के seedless fruit यानी parthenocarpy। बिना fertilization के विकसित होता animal egg यानी parthenogenesis।
Source कहता है ये तिकड़ी लगातार पूछी जाती है, और लगातार भारी शब्द है। तीन अलग डिब्बे रखिए, और product से छाँटिए — seed, fruit, या animal — कभी उस prefix से नहीं जो इत्तेफ़ाक़ से साझा है।
दूसरा pitfall: ये दावा कि apomixis में meiosis या syngamy होती है। ये उल्टा करती है। ये दोनों छोड़ देती है। और यही झूठा बयान पूरे chapter का पसंदीदा assertion–reason trap है।
आपने इसे अभी worked example चार में चलते देखा। Reason वाजिब लग रहा था, सही vocabulary इस्तेमाल कर रहा था, एक सच्ची assertion के बग़ल में बैठा था — और mechanism का बिल्कुल उल्टा कह रहा था।
<curious> अब देखिए दोनों pitfalls में साझा क्या है, क्योंकि ये देख लेना दोनों को रटने से ज़्यादा क़ीमती है। दोनों एक जाना-पहचाना शब्द पढ़कर एक जानी-पहचानी प्रक्रिया मान लेने से आते हैं।

Apomixis ovule इस्तेमाल करती है। Seed बनाती है। बाहर से ये बिल्कुल उसी sexual रास्ते जैसी दिखती है जिसे बनाने में हमने तीन parts लगाए। तो दिमाग़ ख़ुद-ब-ख़ुद meiosis और syngamy भर देता है, क्योंकि उनकी जगह वहीं है।
लेकिन वही मिलती-जुलती शक्ल तो mimics शब्द का पूरा मक़सद है। Apomixis बनी ही इसलिए है कि sexual दिखे जबकि हो कुछ और — और examiner ठीक उसी भ्रम का फ़ायदा उठा रहा है जो plant ने विकसित किया।

sections.title: Pitfalls 3 and 4, and the tag that answers almost every MCQ here

board_events.text: PITFALL 3 · 'Apomixis creates variation'
NO — it is CLONAL, so it produces NO new variation.
If a question links apomixis (or nucellar polyembryony) to 'variation', THAT OPTION IS WRONG.
PITFALL 4 · 'Nucellar embryos are from the egg'
NO — they are from DIPLOID NUCELLAR (maternal) tissue, which is exactly WHY they are clones.
PRO-TIP (accuracy) · Tag every term
CLONAL — apomixis, nucellar / adventive embryony, vegetative reproduction → no variation, diploid, maternal. SEXUAL — syngamy, normal embryo sac → variation, involves meiosis.
Almost every MCQ here is testing WHICH BOX a term belongs in.

segments.text: Two pitfalls left, and then the tag that closes out this subtopic — and, the source claims, almost every multiple-choice question in it.
Pitfall three: believing apomixis creates variation. It does not. It is clonal, so it produces no new variation. And this one has a wonderfully blunt exam consequence.
If a question links apomixis — or nucellar polyembryony — to variation, that option is wrong. You do not need to read the rest of it. The association itself is the error.
Pitfall four: thinking nucellar embryos come from the egg. They do not. They come from diploid nucellar, maternal, tissue — and that origin is exactly why they are clones.

Trace it once more and it cannot slip. The egg is haploid and it is the sexual route. The nucellus is diploid and it is the mother's own body. An embryo from the egg is a sexual product; an embryo from the nucellus is a copy.
<excited> Now the pro-tip, and it is unusually powerful. Tag every term in this subtopic as either clonal or sexual. Just two boxes, and every term goes in one of them.
Clonal: apomixis, nucellar and adventive embryony, vegetative reproduction. And the tag carries three properties with it — no variation, diploid, maternal. One label, three facts.
Sexual: syngamy, the normal embryo sac. Variation, and involves meiosis. That is the whole toolkit — because almost every M C Q here is testing which box a term belongs in, and nothing more.
दो pitfalls बाक़ी, और फिर वो tag जो इस subtopic को ख़त्म कर देता है — और source के मुताबिक़, इसके लगभग हर multiple-choice question को भी।
तीसरा pitfall: ये मानना कि apomixis variation बनाती है। नहीं बनाती। ये clonal है, इसलिए कोई नई variation पैदा नहीं करती। और इसका exam वाला नतीजा बेहद सीधा है।
अगर कोई question apomixis को — या nucellar polyembryony को — variation से जोड़े, तो वो option ग़लत है। बाक़ी पढ़ने की ज़रूरत ही नहीं। वो जोड़ ख़ुद ही ग़लती है।
चौथा pitfall: ये सोचना कि nucellar embryos egg से आते हैं। नहीं आते। वो diploid nucellar, यानी maternal, tissue से आते हैं — और यही origin उन्हें clones बनाती है।

इसे एक बार और trace कीजिए और ये फिसलेगा नहीं। Egg haploid है और वो sexual रास्ता है। Nucellus diploid है और वो माँ का अपना शरीर है। Egg से बना embryo sexual उत्पाद है; nucellus से बना embryo एक copy है।
<excited> अब pro-tip, और ये असामान्य रूप से ताक़तवर है। इस subtopic के हर term पर या तो clonal का tag लगाइए, या sexual का। बस दो डिब्बे, और हर term इनमें से एक में जाता है।
Clonal: apomixis, nucellar और adventive embryony, vegetative reproduction। और ये tag अपने साथ तीन ख़ूबियाँ लाता है — कोई variation नहीं, diploid, maternal। एक label, तीन facts।
Sexual: syngamy, सामान्य embryo sac। यानी variation, और meiosis शामिल। बस यही पूरा औज़ार है — क्योंकि यहाँ का लगभग हर M C Q यही जाँच रहा है कि term किस डिब्बे का है, और कुछ नहीं।

sections.title: Cheat sheet — the whole chapter on one page

board_events.text: SEXUAL REPRODUCTION IN FLOWERING PLANTS — full chapter recap

MALE LINE — Anther: bilobed, tetragonal, 4 microsporangia. Wall (outside→in): epidermis, endothecium, middle layers, tapetum (nutritive, multinucleate). Microsporogenesis: PMC (2n) → meiosis → tetrad of 4 microspores (n) → pollen. Pollen wall: exine (sporopollenin, germ pores) + intine (cellulose + pectin). Shed 2-celled (vegetative + generative) or 3-celled.

FEMALE LINE — Pistil: stigma, style, ovary; ovules on the placenta. Ovule = integumented megasporangium (funicle, hilum, integuments, nucellus, micropyle, chalaza). Megasporogenesis: MMC (2n) → meiosis → 4 megaspores → 3 degenerate → 1 functional (n). Then 3 MITOTIC divisions → embryo sac: 7 CELLS, 8 NUCLEI (egg + 2 synergids with filiform apparatus; 3 antipodals; central cell with 2 polar nuclei).

POLLINATION — Autogamy (same flower: wheat, rice, pea) · Geitonogamy (same plant — functionally cross, GENETICALLY SELF: Cucurbita) · Xenogamy (different plant: papaya, maize). Agents: anemophily (wind), hydrophily (water, ~50 genera: Vallisneria, Zostera), entomophily (insects), ornithophily (birds), chiropterophily (bats). Outbreeding devices: dichogamy, self-incompatibility, unisexuality.

ARTIFICIAL HYBRIDISATION — select parents → emasculate (BISEXUAL flowers only) → bag → collect pollen → dust → re-bag. Emasculation prevents selfing; bagging prevents contamination. Pollen: viability varies; stored in pollen banks (liquid nitrogen); Parthenium causes allergy. Yucca–Pronuba = obligate mutualism.

DOUBLE FERTILISATION — two male gametes in ONE embryo sac; UNIQUE TO ANGIOSPERMS. Syngamy: male gamete + egg → ZYGOTE (2n) → embryo. Triple fusion: male gamete + 2 polar nuclei → PEN (3n) → endosperm (via PEC). Synergids and antipodals degenerate after fertilisation.
PLOIDY LADDER — gamete / synergid / antipodal / egg = n · zygote = 2n · PEN / endosperm = 3n. Write n once, then read everything off the ladder.

POST-FERTILISATION — Endosperm BEFORE embryo. Types: nuclear (commonest; coconut water = free-nuclear, kernel = cellular), cellular, helobial. Embryo at the micropylar end; dicot = 2 cotyledons (epicotyl→plumule, hypocotyl→radicle); monocot = scutellum, coleoptile (plumule), coleorhiza (radicle). Ovule→SEED (coat = testa + tegmen), ovary→FRUIT (wall = pericarp). Albuminous (endosperm stays: wheat, castor) vs non-albuminous (gone: pea). Perisperm = nucellus remnant (black pepper). True fruit (ovary only: mango) vs false fruit (thalamus too: apple).

APOMIXIS & POLYEMBRYONY — Apomixis = seed WITHOUT meiosis + fertilisation; asexual but mimics sexual; offspring are CLONES; term by Winkler (1908); common in grasses & Asteraceae; preserves hybrid vigour. Polyembryony = more than one embryo per seed (Citrus, Mangifera, onion, groundnut); first seen by Leeuwenhoek (1719). Nucellar embryony: embryos from diploid maternal nucellar tissue → clones, disease-free, superior to vegetative propagation. Routes: diplospory · apospory · adventive embryony. DIAGNOSTIC SIGN: apomictic embryo sac looks normal but is DIPLOID.

THE FOUR MNEMONICS — 'Select, Emasculate, Bag, Dust, Re-bag — Every Bachelor Diligently Records.' · 'Triple fusion → triploid; two for the baby, three for the food.' · 'Apomixis = a photocopy seed — mitosis only, mother only, no variation.' · And the three boxes: SEED → apomixis · SEEDLESS FRUIT → parthenocarpy · ANIMAL EGG → parthenogenesis.

segments.text: This is the whole chapter on one page. Do not try to learn anything new here — use this to check that the scaffolding is still standing, and go back to the part where it is not.

The male line. Anther: bilobed, tetragonal, four microsporangia. Wall from outside in: epidermis, endothecium, middle layers, tapetum — nutritive and multinucleate. Pollen mother cell, two n, meiosis, tetrad of four microspores, n. Exine of sporopollenin with germ pores; intine of cellulose and pectin. Shed two-celled, sometimes three.

The female line. Pistil: stigma, style, ovary, with ovules on the placenta. The ovule is an integumented megasporangium — funicle, hilum, integuments, nucellus, micropyle, chalaza. Megaspore mother cell, two n, meiosis, four megaspores, three degenerate, one functional, n. Then three mitotic divisions give seven cells and eight nuclei.

Pollination. Autogamy in the same flower — wheat, rice, pea. Geitonogamy on the same plant, functionally cross but genetically self — Cucurbita. Xenogamy to a different plant — papaya, maize. Agents: wind, water, insects, birds, bats. Outbreeding devices: dichogamy, self-incompatibility, unisexuality.

Artificial hybridisation. Select parents, emasculate — bisexual flowers only — bag, collect pollen, dust, re-bag. Emasculation prevents selfing; bagging prevents contamination. Pollen banks use liquid nitrogen; Parthenium causes allergy; Yucca and Pronuba are an obligate mutualism.

Double fertilisation. Two male gametes in one embryo sac, unique to angiosperms. Syngamy gives the zygote at two n, which becomes the embryo. Triple fusion gives the primary endosperm nucleus at three n, which becomes the endosperm. Synergids and antipodals degenerate afterwards.

And the ladder, which you should be able to recite without the page. Gamete, synergid, antipodal and egg are n. The zygote is two n. The primary endosperm nucleus and endosperm are three n. Write n once, read everything else off it.

Post-fertilisation. Endosperm before embryo. Nuclear, cellular, helobial — coconut water is free-nuclear, the kernel cellular. Dicot embryo, two cotyledons; monocot, scutellum with coleoptile and coleorhiza. Ovule to seed, ovary to fruit, ovary wall to pericarp. Albuminous keeps its endosperm; non-albuminous does not. True fruit is mango; false fruit is apple.

Apomixis and polyembryony. Seed without meiosis and fertilisation; clones; Winkler, nineteen hundred and eight; preserves hybrid vigour. Polyembryony, more than one embryo per seed; Leeuwenhoek, seventeen nineteen. Nucellar embryony gives disease-free clones. Routes: diplospory, apospory, adventive embryony. And the diagnostic sign — the sac looks normal but is diploid.

<excited> Finally the four mnemonics. Select, Emasculate, Bag, Dust, Re-bag — Every Bachelor Diligently Records. Triple fusion gives triploid: two for the baby, three for the food. Apomixis is a photocopy seed — mitosis only, mother only, no variation. And the three boxes: seed, apomixis; seedless fruit, parthenocarpy; animal egg, parthenogenesis. That is the chapter.
ये पूरा chapter एक पन्ने पर है। यहाँ कुछ नया सीखने की कोशिश मत कीजिए — इससे बस जाँचिए कि ढाँचा अब भी खड़ा है, और जहाँ नहीं है वहाँ उस part पर लौट जाइए।

Male line। Anther: bilobed, tetragonal, चार microsporangia। Wall बाहर से अंदर: epidermis, endothecium, middle layers, tapetum — nutritive और multinucleate। Pollen mother cell, two n, meiosis, चार microspores का tetrad, n। Exine sporopollenin का, germ pores के साथ; intine cellulose और pectin की। Two-celled shed होता है, कभी three-celled।

Female line। Pistil: stigma, style, ovary, और placenta पर ovules। Ovule एक integumented megasporangium है — funicle, hilum, integuments, nucellus, micropyle, chalaza। Megaspore mother cell, two n, meiosis, चार megaspores, तीन degenerate, एक functional, n। फिर तीन mitotic divisions से सात cells और आठ nuclei।

Pollination। उसी flower में autogamy — wheat, rice, pea। उसी plant पर geitonogamy, functionally cross लेकिन genetically self — Cucurbita। दूसरे plant पर xenogamy — papaya, maize। Agents: हवा, पानी, कीड़े, पक्षी, चमगादड़। Outbreeding devices: dichogamy, self-incompatibility, unisexuality।

Artificial hybridisation। Parents चुनिए, emasculate कीजिए — सिर्फ़ bisexual flowers में — bag, pollen collect, dust, re-bag। Emasculation selfing रोकता है; bagging contamination रोकती है। Pollen banks liquid nitrogen इस्तेमाल करते हैं; Parthenium allergy देता है; Yucca और Pronuba obligate mutualism हैं।

Double fertilization। एक ही embryo sac में दो male gametes, और ये सिर्फ़ angiosperms में। Syngamy से zygote, two n, जो embryo बनता है। Triple fusion से primary endosperm nucleus, three n, जो endosperm बनता है। Synergids और antipodals उसके बाद degenerate हो जाते हैं।
और ladder, जो आपको बिना पन्ने के आनी चाहिए। Gamete, synergid, antipodal और egg — n। Zygote — two n। Primary endosperm nucleus और endosperm — three n। n एक बार लिखिए, बाक़ी सब वहीं से पढ़ लीजिए।

Post-fertilization। Endosperm embryo से पहले। Nuclear, cellular, helobial — coconut water free-nuclear है, kernel cellular। Dicot embryo में दो cotyledons; monocot में scutellum, coleoptile और coleorhiza के साथ। Ovule से seed, ovary से fruit, ovary wall से pericarp। Albuminous endosperm रखता है; non-albuminous नहीं। True fruit आम है; false fruit सेब।

Apomixis और polyembryony। बिना meiosis और fertilization के seed; clones; Winkler, उन्नीस सौ आठ; hybrid vigour बचाती है। Polyembryony, एक seed में एक से ज़्यादा embryo; Leeuwenhoek, सत्रह सौ उन्नीस। Nucellar embryony disease-free clones देती है। Routes: diplospory, apospory, adventive embryony। और पहचान का चिह्न — sac normal दिखती है लेकिन diploid है।

<excited> आख़िर में चारों mnemonics। Select, Emasculate, Bag, Dust, Re-bag — Every Bachelor Diligently Records। Triple fusion देता है triploid: दो बच्चे के लिए, तीन खाने के लिए। Apomixis एक photocopy seed है — सिर्फ़ mitosis, सिर्फ़ माँ, कोई variation नहीं। और तीन डिब्बे: seed, apomixis; seedless fruit, parthenocarpy; animal egg, parthenogenesis। बस, यही पूरा chapter है।
